    • closePlayerInventory

      void closePlayerInventory() throws IllegalStateException
      Closes the Inventory of this InventoryUserInterface save. If the player's opened inventory is not the one returned by InventoryHolder.getInventory() it should not be closed.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - thrown if the inventory was not opened

      This method should contain code to render the interface of this UserInterface. The UserInterface should not be shown until UniversalUserInterface.show(Player) is called.
